First public release of lazybw, a keyboard-first terminal UI for the
Bitwarden vault. It drives the official Bitwarden CLI (`bw` 2025.9.0 or
newer), which you install separately.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `lazybw-1.0.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` | any Linux on x86_64 (static binary) |
| `lazybw-1.0.0-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` | any Linux on ARM64, including Termux on Android |
| `lazybw_1.0.0-1_amd64.deb`, `lazybw_1.0.0-1_arm64.deb` | Debian, Ubuntu and derivatives |
| `lazybw-1.0.0-1.x86_64.rpm`, `lazybw-1.0.0-1.aarch64.rpm` | Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL and derivatives |
| `lazybw-1.0.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst`, `lazybw-1.0.0-1-aarch64.pkg.tar.zst` | Arch Linux, Arch Linux ARM |
| `SHA256SUMS` | checksums of all of the above |

On Arch Linux it is also in the AUR, as `lazybw-bin` (this release's binary)
and `lazybw` (built from source).

A container image with `bw` included is on the GitHub Container Registry:

```sh
docker run -it --rm -v lazybw:/home/lazybw ghcr.io/syscallbrain/lazybw:1.0.0
```

The [user guide](https://syscallbrain.github.io/lazybw/) covers installation
and everything else. The full list of features is in the
[changelog](https://github.com/SyscallBrain/lazybw/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md).
